# Font library licences

Generated by `scripts/fetch-fonts.js`. 257 families. Each family folder (`assets/fonts/library/<slug>/`, `assets/fonts/cjk/<slug>/`, `assets/fonts/originals/<slug>/`) carries `LICENSE.txt` with the copyright notice and the full licence text. Font files are unmodified copies from the listed npm package (Fontsource, built from github.com/google/fonts). The preview files in `assets/fonts/previews/` are subsets of the same fonts, used only under internal names (never under a Reserved Font Name).
